text:
incbot: Incident created • Sev=P2 • Reason: multiple serving containers restarting from GPU OOM during prefill (long-context requests). Pager: @priya • Link: <https://pagerduty.example/INC1919004321>

elena: seeing a flood of OOMs on inference-prod nodes gk-prod-10 / gk-prod-12, starting ~10:12 UTC. Containers are restarting repeatedly on the prefill step.

mike: same here. stack traces show CUDA OOM right when allocating KV cache for prefill. Sample log:
```
E tensorflow: ResourceExhaustedError: Ran out of memory when attempting to allocate 3584.00MiB for buffer
CUDA error: out of memory. GPU 0 (14.7 GiB total, 12.9 GiB free) attempted alloc 3.5GiB
at inference/runtime/prefill.cc:312
```

elena: affected model: rdl/long-context-v2 (32k window). Traffic concentration from a few customer apps hitting large system messages + user history.

jon: customer impact: intermittent 500s for ~4% of requests to /v1/chat for that model. Confirmed support ticket from acme-corp reporting timeouts.

mike: mitigation attempts so far:
- scaled replicas down from 24->16 to reduce concurrent prefill pressure
- applied a temporary route rule to send new sessions for rdl/long-context-v2 to a smaller-capacity pool
- attempted hotfix to reduce `max_prefill_tokens` from 8192->2048 via runtime config, but it didn't fully take before pods restarted

priya: can we abort existing prefill requests that exceed threshold? If we can kill long-running prefill ops at the proxy we can stop restarts.

elena: adding a prefill cutoff on the edge for the model now. Patching gate config:
```
PATCH /internal/gate/config
{
  "model": "rdl/long-context-v2",
  "prefill_cutoff_tokens": 4096
}
```

mike: did that. edge accepted the patch, new requests above 4k tokens are rejected with 413 until further notice.

jon: also routing 30% of traffic to rdl/long-context-v2-quant (q8) as a fallback. Quant variant uses less GPU memory for KV cache.

elena: observed immediate drop in OOM rate after the cutoff + quant fallback. Node gk-prod-12 still flapping but stabilized after pod restarts finished. Current error rate down from ~12/min to ~1-2/min.

priya: I'm taking on-call from here. Handoff notes: root cause likely heavy prefill memory from extremely long combined prompt + conversation history. Hits particular customer flows that stitch large system prompts.

mike: action items I'm doing before handoff complete:
- collect heap snapshots and KV cache sizes for failing pods
- snapshot kube events and restart counts: `kubectl get events --field-selector involvedObject.name=serving-pod-xyz` and upload to incident artifacts
- schedule a canary for reduced `max_prefill_tokens` config across more instances

elena: customer comms: support has a pinned update for affected tenants. For Acme we confirmed partial outage window 10:12-10:38 UTC with degraded responses.

priya: noted. I'll join customer sync in 10m. Also creating a postmortem branch: /incidents/1919004321-prefill-oom-postmortem. Please add any logs/config diffs.

jon: long-term mitigations proposed:
- enforce conservative default max_prefill_tokens per model family
- improve prefill admission control that counts KV cache cost before scheduling onto GPU
- add per-request token-limited fallback to quantized model before attempting prefill on high-memory nodes

mike: +1 to admission control. Also thinking about routing policy: prefer nodes with more free GPU headroom for prefill-heavy requests.

elena: note — one pod exhibited a CUDA driver error during restart sequence (driver reset) on gk-prod-12, filing separate infra bug for node health checks.

priya: handoff complete to me at 10:45 UTC. I'll keep monitoring and coordinate post-incident review tomorrow. Tagging owners: @mike (runtime), @elena (serving), @jon (oncall-sre).

incbot: Incident acknowledged by priya. Status: mitigated -> monitoring. Severity downscaled to P3.

priya: final checklist before closing:
- upload logs and restart counters (mike)
- draft customer update for affected tenants (support)
- create postmortem and assign action owners (priya)

mike: logs and artifacts uploaded to /artifacts/INC1919004321.tar.gz

elena: I'll follow up on the node driver instability and add to infra backlog.

priya: closing notes: immediate mitigation (prefill cutoff + quant fallback) prevented further container restarts. Root cause likely workload causing KV cache to exceed model memory budget. Postmortem to include ticketed actions for admission control and model defaults.

priya: closing thread at 10:52 UTC, will reopen if regressions show up.
